dialogue.content: テストですこんにちは本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, this is a test. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます
dialogue.English: We will begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: こんにちわ
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: はじめにどうお呼びさせていただければいいですか？
dialogue.English: To start, how would you like me to address you?

dialogue.content: みくと申します
dialogue.English: My name is Miku.

dialogue.content: みくさんですねよろしくお願します
dialogue.English: Miku, correct? It’s a pleasure to work with you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: You too.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 来週手術なんです
dialogue.English: I’m scheduled for surgery next week.

dialogue.content: それはとてもふあんですね
dialogue.English: That must make you very anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのような手術か詳しく教えていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about what kind of surgery it is?

dialogue.content: 癌です
dialogue.English: It’s for cancer.

dialogue.content: それは怖いですね
dialogue.English: That must be frightening.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すごく
dialogue.English: Very.

dialogue.content: 怖くて不安ですよね
dialogue.English: You must feel scared and anxious.

dialogue.content: とても
dialogue.English: Very much so.

dialogue.content: 今はどのような状況なのですか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 不安と恐怖でMAXです
dialogue.English: My anxiety and fear are at their peak.

dialogue.content: 先が見えなくて辛いですよね
dialogue.English: It must be painful not being able to see what's ahead.

dialogue.content: 死を覚悟しなきゃないです
dialogue.English: I have to prepare myself for death.

dialogue.content: それは目の前が真っ暗な感じですよね
dialogue.English: It must feel like everything in front of you has gone dark.

dialogue.content: すごく深い暗闇です
dialogue.English: It’s a very deep darkness.

dialogue.content: それはどうしたらいいかわからないですよね
dialogue.English: It leaves you not knowing what to do, doesn’t it.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 周りに今のようなお話を出来る方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone around you that you can talk to about this?

dialogue.content: いません、気をつかわせるので
dialogue.English: No, because I don't want to burden them.

dialogue.content: 自分自身話したくありません
dialogue.English: I don't want to talk about it myself.

dialogue.content: 自分のつらいはなしですからね
dialogue.English: Because it’s a painful thing to talk about.

dialogue.content: その中でもよくご相談くださいました
dialogue.English: I really appreciate you coming to talk about it despite that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とても勇気のいる行動だっと思いますがどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I think that took a lot of courage—how does that feel to you?

dialogue.content: そうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は入院されているのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you currently hospitalized?

dialogue.content: 来週からです
dialogue.English: Starting next week.

dialogue.content: 自宅で療養中なのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're resting at home for now.

dialogue.content: 手術が怖いのと、転移してたら・・・・
dialogue.English: I’m scared of the surgery, and what if it has spread...

dialogue.content: 不安と恐怖です
dialogue.English: I’m full of anxiety and fear.

dialogue.content: じっとしてられません
dialogue.English: I can’t sit still.

dialogue.content: 自宅にいるとそう考えますよね
dialogue.English: It's natural to think that way when you're at home.

dialogue.content: 外に出る気にはなれません
dialogue.English: I don’t feel like going outside.

dialogue.content: 人と会う気にもなれません
dialogue.English: I don't feel like seeing anyone either.

dialogue.content: 病気についてお医者さんはどのように説明されているのですか？
dialogue.English: What has your doctor told you about your illness?

dialogue.content: ご飯も食べれません
dialogue.English: I can't even eat.

dialogue.content: 手術して腫瘍を取り切れるか・・・
dialogue.English: I’m worried whether the surgery will be able to remove the tumor completely...

dialogue.content: 頑張るって言ってました
dialogue.English: They said they’d do their best.

dialogue.content: 余命は、わからないと
dialogue.English: They said they don’t know my life expectancy.

dialogue.content: そういわれると余計に不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: Hearing that must make you even more anxious.

dialogue.content: 私まだ33才です
dialogue.English: I’m only 33.

dialogue.content: まだまだ生きたい
dialogue.English: I still want to live so much.

dialogue.content: 生きたいですよね
dialogue.English: You want to live, don't you.

dialogue.content: 生きたい
dialogue.English: I want to live.

dialogue.content: とても生きたいですよね
dialogue.English: You really want to live.

dialogue.content: とても生きたい
dialogue.English: I really want to live.

dialogue.content: 手術が成功したらどうしたいですか？
dialogue.English: If the surgery is successful, what would you like to do?

dialogue.content: 普通に生活していきたいです普通に生きていきたい
dialogue.English: I want to live a normal life—I just want to live normally.

dialogue.content: 普通に生きて生活することに希望をもたれているんですね？
dialogue.English: So you're holding onto the hope of living a normal life?

dialogue.content: 普通でいいのです、希望と言うか、普通がいいです
dialogue.English: Normal is enough. It's not so much hope, I just want what's normal.

dialogue.content: みくさんにとって普通の生活とはどういったことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Miku, what does a normal life mean to you?

dialogue.content: 3食ご飯たべて、普通に生活できればいいです
dialogue.English: Eating three meals a day, just being able to live normally is enough.

dialogue.content: 今は不安で食べれないですものね
dialogue.English: Right now, you're too anxious to eat, aren't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ３食食べれるのが嬉しいですよね
dialogue.English: Being able to eat three meals would feel wonderful, wouldn’t it.

dialogue.content: はい、いいですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that would be nice.

dialogue.content: どういった物を食べたいですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things would you like to eat?

dialogue.content: 白米が一番です
dialogue.English: White rice is the best.

dialogue.content: お味噌汁と
dialogue.English: And miso soup.

dialogue.content: 和食ですやね
dialogue.English: Japanese food, I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 心が暖まって美味しいですよね
dialogue.English: It’s heartwarming and delicious, isn’t it.

dialogue.content: いいですね
dialogue.English: That sounds nice.

dialogue.content: 何か思い出がありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any memories associated with it?

dialogue.content: 涙出てきました
dialogue.English: I'm starting to tear up.

dialogue.content: 思い出は特にないです
dialogue.English: I don't have any particular memories.

dialogue.content: 白米とお味噌汁で感動されているのですね
dialogue.English: You’re feeling moved by the thought of white rice and miso soup.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな普通の生活を続けたいです
dialogue.English: I want to continue that kind of normal life.

dialogue.content: ずーーっと
dialogue.English: For a long, long time.

dialogue.content: まだまだこれからですものね
dialogue.English: You still have so much ahead of you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 食べる以外にはありますか？普通にやりたいことが
dialogue.English: Besides eating, is there anything else you'd like to do in your normal life?

dialogue.content: 散歩ですかね
dialogue.English: Maybe taking walks.

dialogue.content: いいですね
dialogue.English: That sounds nice.

dialogue.content: どのようなところを散歩されますか？
dialogue.English: Where would you like to take those walks?

dialogue.content: 家の周りです
dialogue.English: Around my house.

dialogue.content: 近所です
dialogue.English: In my neighborhood.

dialogue.content: 近所はいつも散歩されているのですか？
dialogue.English: Do you usually take walks around your neighborhood?

dialogue.content: いいえ、ないです。これからやりたいです。
dialogue.English: No, I don't. It's something I want to start doing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。やりたいことがおありなんですね？
dialogue.English: I see. So there are things you want to do?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ずっと考えておられたんですか？
dialogue.English: Have you been thinking about that for a while?

dialogue.content: 病気なってからです
dialogue.English: Since I got sick.

dialogue.content: 病気になって良くなった何をしようか？と考えておられたのですね
dialogue.English: So, since becoming ill, you’ve been thinking about what you’d like to do when you get better.

dialogue.content: 普通に生活したいとおもってるだけです
dialogue.English: I'm just thinking that I want to live a normal life.

dialogue.content: みくさんにとっての普通は
dialogue.English: So for you, Miku, 'normal' is...

dialogue.content: ３食白米とみそ汁を食べて
dialogue.English: ...eating three meals of white rice and miso soup,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 近所を散歩をして
dialogue.English: ...taking walks around your neighborhood,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ずーっと生きていたい
dialogue.English: ...and wanting to live for a long, long time.

dialogue.content: ということですね？
dialogue.English: Is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、そんなかんじです
dialogue.English: Yes, something like that.

dialogue.content: 今までのことをまとめさせていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 来週癌の手術があり
dialogue.English: You have cancer surgery next week,

dialogue.content: とても不安でつらい。さきが見えない。
dialogue.English: ...and you're feeling very anxious and distressed. You can't see what the future holds.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自宅にいるが外に出たくなく誰にも会いたくない
dialogue.English: You're at home, but you don't want to go out or see anyone.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでも生きたい、生きて普通の生活を
dialogue.English: Even so, you want to live. To live a normal life.

dialogue.content: ３食食べて散歩をする普通の
dialogue.English: A normal life where you eat three meals and take walks.

dialogue.content: 生活をしたいと考えている
dialogue.English: That's the life you're hoping for.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: ここまで話をされてどのように感じておられますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel now that we've talked about this?

dialogue.content: そのとおりです。聞いてくださり有難うございます。
dialogue.English: That’s exactly it. Thank you for listening.

dialogue.content: 話をされたことで気持ちが楽になりましたか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel a little lighter after talking about it?

dialogue.content: はい、有難うございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 生きることをとても強く思われている、みくさんは
dialogue.English: Miku, you have such a strong will to live.

dialogue.content: きっと希望している普通の生活を迎えれる
dialogue.English: I'm sure you'll be able to have the normal life you're hoping for.

dialogue.content: 準備が出来ているのだと思いますので、
dialogue.English: I believe you are ready for it.

dialogue.content: 手術までは不安でしょうが、やってみたいことを思い浮かべながら
dialogue.English: I know you'll be anxious until the surgery, but perhaps by picturing the things you want to do,

dialogue.content: 乗り切ってもらえたらと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: you can get through this. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい、そうしたいと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like to try that.

dialogue.content: 話を聞いていただき有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.content: はい。こちらこそご一緒できて良かったです。
dialogue.English: Of course. I'm glad I could be here with you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでは本日の相談を終わりたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Then, I'd like to bring today’s session to a close.

dialogue.content: はい、有難うございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: これでロールプレイを終わりたいと思いますがよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I’d like to end the role-play here, if that’s alright.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これで終了します。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: This concludes the session. Thank you.
